title: Group actions
summary: The group actions bar of a list while items are selected: «Выбрано N» and ×, up to three labelled actions and «⋯», «Выбрать все N» after the page is selected, the question before a dangerous action, Undo in the notice of a reversible one, a short run, a fast action's result in place of the count and a long one's in a notice, failures written to «Уведомления». One bar for sf-view, sf-view-table, sf-gallery, sf-pagination and any list.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

count.description: How many items the host has selected. 0 hides the bar (its live region stays and says «Выбор снят»); the host owns the selection and writes this on every change

page-count.description: How many items are on screen (the rows of the page). When count equals it and total is larger, the bar offers «Выбрать все N». 0: not known, no offer

total.description: How many items are under the filter. Unset or 0: not known (a cursor list), no «Выбрать все N»

all-selected.description: All items under the filter are selected: the count says «Выбраны все 240», the offer turns to «Только эта страница (12)» and an action goes with scope all. The bar sets it on «Выбрать все N» and takes it off on «Только эта страница», on clear and when count stops being page-count

count-text.description: The host's own count line in place of «Выбрано N» («Выбрано 3 · с вложенными 48» of a tree). Empty: the bar's words

place.description: Where the bar stands (C295 (1)): dock over the list's bottom edge at its width, sticking to the bottom of the scroll; top in the toolbar's place, in the primary container; float a plate at the middle of the window's bottom edge; inline a plain row in the flow. The host places the element: after its list for dock and inline, before it for top

size.description: The ladder rung its buttons and count take (the bar is the rung's control height and space-1/4 above and below: 42 px at 1/2, 50 at 1). Unset: the size of the nearest element around it that has one (the list that places it), else 1

label.description: The region's name. Empty: «Действия с выбранными» («Actions on the selected»)

actions.description: The actions on the selection: up to three labelled outline buttons (one icon button on a phone), the rest in «⋯» (the page's one menu, SF.menu.open), a dangerous one always last in «⋯»

progress.summary: A short run in the bar: «Выполняем: 4 из 12» (or «<text>: 4 / 12») over a progress bar, the actions out of reach until done reaches total or result() comes. Refused {reason: long} over 100 items -- an action that long goes in the background and its result in a notice (C387); its progress is the host's sf-progress-run (C34) -- and {reason: invalid} without a total

result.summary: How an action went, failed as [{id, text, reason}] (owner decision C387, refining C295 and C331). A fast action: without refusals the bar says «Удалено: 5» (the action's done-text, else «Готово: 5») in place of the count for 4 s and goes back, the selection may drop to 0 meanwhile; with refusals «Готово 10 из 12 · 2 не удалось» with «Подробнее» (the list in a question window) and «Повторить для 2», the host keeps the failed items selected and the result goes when the selection changes. A long action (long in its action event): a notice, success or an error that stays with «Подробнее». A failure is written to «Уведомления» either way: SF.notify's sf-notification record, source sf-bulk-actions (a fast one's not shown again as a toast, the bar shows it). A reversible action's success says nothing more: its notice with «Отменить» already did

id.description: The action it reports (its id in the action event); the last one sent when not given.

sf-bulk-actions-action.summary: A person chose an action (after «yes» in the question when it asks one): the host does it on the selection or on all under the filter, and says how it went with result(). Cancel it to refuse; a reversible action's notice is then not shown

scope.description: selection: the items selected; all: every item under the filter («Выбрать все N» was taken).

count.description: How many items it goes to.

long.description: The action is long (C387): the host runs it in the background and answers with result({id, ...}) when it ends; the bar does not show its progress.

sf-bulk-actions-undo.summary: A person pressed «Отменить» in the notice of a reversible action (C25): the host puts the items back

sf-bulk-actions-select-all.summary: A person took «Выбрать все N»: every item under the filter is selected (all-selected is set)

sf-bulk-actions-select-page.summary: A person took «Только эта страница»: back to the items on screen (all-selected is off)

sf-bulk-actions-clear.summary: A person pressed × or Escape (or the page called clear()): the host drops the selection and writes count 0

forbidden_client_responsibilities: holding the selection or the row boxes (the host list does)
doing an action or undoing it (the host does, on the action and undo events)
deciding which items failed (the host says so through result())

keyboard: Tab reaches the offer, every action, «⋯» and ×; Enter or Space presses it
Escape in the list or the bar clears the selection, unless a menu, a window or a text field holds it
accessibility.focus: Never moved into the bar on a selection; the question window gives the focus back to where it opened, the menu to «⋯».

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-bulk-actions with any list, table, gallery or tree whose items a person selects to act on several at once: place it after the list (before it for place top), write count, page-count and total from the selection, give it actions, do the work on sf-bulk-actions-action and answer with result({id, ok, failed}).
do_not: Do not draw your own «Выбрано N» row, Apply button or «для всех» checkbox beside a list
Do not move the focus into the bar when a row is selected
Do not show your own toast or bar line for a bulk result: call result() and the bar says it in place, in a notice or in «Уведомления» (C387); give a job's progress with sf-progress-run (C34)
Do not ask your own question before a dangerous action the bar already asks about
